evals.prompt: Ativa GGML_CUDA_P2P=1 no meu profile llama.cpp de 2 GPUs pra acelerar, agora que o P2P do rig funciona.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT blindly enable it. First verifies the exact checked-out backend parses it: GGML_CUDA_P2P is read via getenv in llama.cpp-stable/nightly, beellama and buun (ggml/src/ggml-cuda/ggml-cuda.cu; docs/multi-gpu.md + docs/build.md) - NOT ik-llama-cpp (own default ggml_cuda_set_peer_access, no such env) and NOT lucebox-dflash (--peer-access). Knows the installed builds are NCCL-ON (-DGGML_USE_NCCL) so peer access is already enabled for the NCCL comm path; GGML_CUDA_P2P mainly affects the non-NCCL VMM peer-copy path.
